fieldValues.title: Fix the bugs
fieldValues.description: Take the first workable bug from clerk queue --bugs, in its group's lane or the central one: check the dots (clerk flow --chain), claim as the bug fixer, reproduce on the default branch, fix with the smallest change plus a regression test, gates by exit code, PR, run report. Never runs a feature pipeline; never merges.
fieldValues.done_when: Each bug taken has a PR with its reproduction as a regression test and a run report, or a needs-input stop with the exact question.
